comentarios: A breeding pair displaying a series of alarm calls from exposed branches near the ground in forest edge.  Female was 5 meters from the  male and was most active moving rapidly along the litter and the foliage. Male only moved around the exposed branch where it was perched.  Both were aware of our presence and probably these calls reflects this perturbation.  Recording distance was  5 meters from the female and 10 meters from the male.
